definition.name: Realign Setback Line to Floor Edge
definition.description: Re-offsets one setback line parallel to its nearest straight floor edge at a given distance and trims its joined neighbours along their own curves.
definition.aiDescription: Re-offsets one setback line parallel to its nearest straight floor edge at a given distance and trims its joined neighbours along their own curves.
examples: Moves setback line 12684567 so it is again exactly 4 m from (and parallel to) the floor's P01–P02 edge, and moves the touching ends of its two joined setback arcs along their own arcs to meet it; aborts if anything would move more than 50 mm.
definition.author: mrafaatFK2S3
